description: This file defines a custom exception class NoteResourceNotSupportedException used to indicate that a specific resource is not supported in the context of notes within the Fineract project.

classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a certain resource is not supported for notes.

methods.name: NoteResourceNotSupportedException
